remarks: High-Floor Views. High Ceilings. Downtown Living. Experience Downtown LA from above in Residence 2501 at The Chelsea at 717 Olympic. Located on the 25th floor of this 27-story building, this 805-square-foot, one-bedroom, one-bathroom home features approximately 9.5-foot ceilings, expansive windows, and sweeping city views. The combination of generous ceiling height, natural light, and an elevated vantage point creates an open, airy feel throughout the residence.
